title: Tiny, cute laptop
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- laptop lid / screen -->
  <rect x='18' y='18' width='64' height='44' rx='4' ry='4' fill='#4A6FA5'/>
  <!-- screen display -->
  <rect x='24' y='24' width='52' height='32' rx='2' ry='2' fill='#9FD8FF'/>
  <!-- cute face on screen: eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='38' r='3.5' fill='#3A6EA5'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='38' r='3.5' fill='#3A6EA5'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M42 46 Q50 52 58 46' stroke='#3A6EA5' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- screen shine highlight -->
  <rect x='27' y='27' width='10' height='4' rx='2' fill='#E0F4FF' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- base / keyboard deck -->
  <path d='M10 62 L90 62 L82 74 Q80 78 74 78 L26 78 Q20 78 18 74 Z' fill='#7FA8D9'/>
  <!-- keyboard keys hint -->
  <rect x='26' y='65' width='48' height='9' rx='2' fill='#A9C6EC'/>
  <!-- trackpad -->
  <rect x='42' y='75' width='16' height='1.5' rx='0.75' fill='#5D87C4'/>
  <!-- hinge line -->
  <rect x='18' y='60' width='64' height='4' rx='2' fill='#35548A'/>
</svg>
